plan.environment: Maria's bedroom at night exactly as in the first frame: the bed under the starry window on the left with its grey knit blanket, MACA seated at the bedside, the four-panel door with a light switch at the right, a wooden chest at the lower right, grey-blue walls
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: warm, amused, tender. Arousal: very low.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 a soft dull thump of Chico's tail on the knit blanket; P02 a faint metal creak as MACA's open hand turns toward him; P03 Chico's slow sleepy breath

panels.video_beat: Chico lies asleep on the bed across Maria's feet; MACA's open metal hand turns a little more toward him as if presenting him; Maria on her pillow looks at MACA and then down at Chico
Chico's tail thumps once on the knit blanket without waking him; Maria smiles down at him from her pillow

plan.continuity: Maria on the pillow at the screen-left, under the grey knit blanket; MACA seated at the bedside on the screen-right with her open hand toward Chico and her chest light glowing; Chico, the only dog in the room, asleep on the bed on the blanket across Maria's feet; the four-panel door and the wooden chest at the right stay where they are
preventions: one Chico only, asleep on the bed across Maria's feet from the first frame to the last
never a second dog, never a dog on the floor or the rug, and never a shot of the floor
the camera does not pan, tilt, drop, travel or cut: it holds the same wide view of the bed from the first frame to the last, at most a very slow push-in
the bed, the blanket and the room do not change
MACA's helmet stays a clean smooth round white shell with one round ear disc on each side and nothing attached: no fins, wings, rays, lines, spikes or antennae near her head or ears

design: Replaces V23 f88-f176, where the camera pans down off the bed (both Chicos are in frame at f97-f118: one on the bed, one on the rug) and then sits on a lone Chico on the rug until the cut at f176|f177. Both pins are accepted wide frames of the same view (f84, last clean frame before the pan; f180, after the cut). A pan is exactly what produced the second Chico, so this clip holds the wide; the edit's free push-in supplies the move. 4 s instead of the audit's 6 s.
